name: Refine
source:
Main character enrolls the the university thanks to his sport successes. He joins a basketball club and fosters relations with its members. However, his close friend betrays him...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-january-2003-moekan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角凭借在体育方面的成功而进入大学。他加入了一个篮球俱乐部并与其成员建立了关系。然而，他的挚友却背叛了他……
